core_principles.evidence_first: Authority class alone does NOT validate an assertion. Every validated fact must possess direct, page-addressable citation.
core_principles.agent_role_separation: Knowledge Author agents (e.g. OPENAI_CHATGPT_AETERNUM_KNOWLEDGE_AUTHOR) function solely as AUTHORING_AGENT, never as a BIBLIOGRAPHIC_SOURCE. AI draft facts require external authority corroboration.
core_principles.corpus_self_reference_prohibition: Aeternum memory artifacts and corpus releases (such as AAC-2026.1-R1) are downstream representations and cannot serve as academic validation sources.

TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.description: Official international morphological nomenclature standards (e.g. FIPAT IFAA Terminologia Anatomica).
TERMINOLOGY_AUTHORITY.validation_limits: Does not validate physiological function, detailed surgical approaches, or microscopic pathology.

GROSS_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.description: Comprehensive anatomical treatises (e.g. Latarjet & Ruiz Liard, Gray's Anatomy).
GROSS_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.validation_limits: May not reflect specialized micro-vascular variations or late surgical technique modifications without corroboration.

REGIONAL_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.description: Specialized topographic regional textbooks focusing on specific compartments (e.g. axillary fossa, cervical triangles).
REGIONAL_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.validation_limits: Limited to regional scope; cannot establish global systemic nomenclature.

ANATOMICAL_ATLAS.description: High-fidelity photographic or illustrated dissection atlases (e.g. Nielsen & Miller, Netter, Sobotta).
ANATOMICAL_ATLAS.validation_limits: Illustrations alone without accompanying verified text cannot define quantitative population prevalence.

CLINICAL_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.description: Clinically oriented anatomy literature detailing surgical risks, entrapment syndromes, and biomechanics (e.g. Moore).
CLINICAL_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.validation_limits: May present simplified structural morphology to emphasize clinical relevance.

SPECIALIZED_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.description: Monographs, dedicated osteological treatises, or peer-reviewed anatomical journal articles.
SPECIALIZED_ANATOMY_REFERENCE.validation_limits: Subject to sample size limitations; requires explicit population reporting.

INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHING.description: University dissection manuals, morgue teaching notes, and faculty laboratory protocols.
INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHING.validation_limits: Cannot define disputed canonical truth or overrule established canonical treatises.

INTERNAL_CURATED.description: Internal structured flashcard banks and taxonomy matrices.
INTERNAL_CURATED.validation_limits: Secondary derivative material; holds no independent validation authority.

AI_AUTHORED_DRAFT.description: Hypothetical structured assertions generated by authorized AI agents.
AI_AUTHORED_DRAFT.validation_limits: Strictly candidate status (AI_DRAFT). Zero validation authority.

SYNTHETIC_QA.description: Diagnostic synthetic sentences generated for pipeline smoke tests.
SYNTHETIC_QA.validation_limits: Strictly pipeline test harness; zero validation authority.

TERMINOLOGY.note: Prefer official terminology standard (e.g. TA2); major canonical textbook concordance is acceptable for core terms.

CORE_GROSS_ANATOMY.note: One eligible authoritative treatise (e.g. Latarjet 5a ed) is sufficient to validate undisputed osteological and muscular facts.

CONTESTED_OR_VARIABLE_ANATOMY.note: Variants (e.g. os acromiale, ossified transverse ligament) require multi-source corroboration or a specialized monograph.

CLINICAL_CLAIMS.note: All clinical correlations, nerve injuries, and pathologies require a verified clinical textbook citation.

QUANTITATIVE_VARIATION_AND_PREVALENCE.note: Statistical frequencies or precise millimeter/count metrics cannot be asserted without explicit bibliographic numerical citation.
